jobPostingInfo.title: Associate Software Engineer
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
Company overview

Atlas Mutual is a member-owned insurer serving 2.4 million policyholders. Our Digital Engineering group builds the quoting, claims and customer self-service platforms, and has opened a remote engineering hub for talent in Pakistan.

Position summary

As an Associate Software Engineer you will join the Claims Experience team, building the web and API layers that let members file and track claims online.

Key responsibilities

  • Develop features in our TypeScript and Node.js API layer and React front end.
  • Write unit and integration tests and fix defects found in QA.
  • Work with PostgreSQL and with event streams from our core claims system.
  • Participate in agile ceremonies and code reviews.

Required qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • 1-2 years of experience with JavaScript or TypeScript, including Node.js.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and REST APIs.

Preferred qualifications

  • Java or Spring Boot exposure.
  • Experience with Docker or AWS.
  • Interest in insurance or financial services.

Compensation

PKR 300,000-380,000 per month, paid through our local employer-of-record. Remote within Pakistan, with core hours 13:00-21:00 PKT.
